summary: NVE Corp filed an 8-K to announce the retirement of CEO Daniel A. Baker, effective August 6, 2026, and the appointment of Peter G. Eames as successor. Baker will remain Chairman pending shareholder approval. The filing also notes board nominations for Eames and Caroyln W. Valentine, and approval of Eames' annual base salary of $260,000 plus performance-based compensation. This is a planned CEO succession with no abrupt departure. The event is a routine management transition, not a contested change. No deal terms are present.
